Toast.use: transient feedback that appears because something happened, then goes away

tone.neutral: plain message, no semantic color; the default for most toasts
tone.warning: a condition worth noticing but not blocking
tone.danger: an error; announced assertively instead of politely

presentation.banner: raised floating panel, the toast default
presentation.accent: same panel with a stronger tone accent
presentation.inline: flattened to sit inside surrounding content

rules.ToastRegion: Every Toast is rendered inside a ToastRegion, which owns the live region and the stacking of multiple toasts.
rules.timeout: Pass timeout together with onDismiss to auto-dismiss; a toast with an action should not carry a timeout, since it could disappear before the action is used.
rules.onDismiss: Without onDismiss there is no close button; the toast can only leave through its own timeout.
rules.lifecycle: Toast never removes itself from the DOM. The app owns the array of visible toasts and removes the entry in onDismiss.

Toast.timed: <ToastRegion><Toast timeout={6000} title="Syncing" tone="info">This may take a few seconds.</Toast></ToastRegion>
Toast.action: <ToastRegion><Toast actions={<Button onClick={undo} size="sm" variant="neutral">Undo</Button>} onDismiss={() => remove(id)} title="Document archived">Moved to Archived.</Toast></ToastRegion>
